A majestic illustration of Mansa Musa on horseback during his Hajj journey. He is dressed in rich flowing robes and a golden crown, holding a gold staff. Behind him, a long caravan of camels carrying heavy sacks of gold, and attendants in desert clothing. The background shows sweeping desert dunes.

A bustling marketplace scene in ancient Timbuktu. In the foreground, two merchants in turbans are carefully inspecting a stack of leather-bound Arabic manuscripts. In the background, camels are being unloaded of large white slabs of salt, and the mud-brick architecture of the Sankore Mosque is visible against a clear blue sky.
